verdict.rationale: The docs name specific payroll/HR (Gusto, Rippling) and CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) connectors that feed Ari's planning [docs-18]. Ari is described as keeping one model of the company current alongside ledger actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite or Rillet [docs-30, docs-3], with nightly sync controls [docs-19]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that headcount and pipeline fields map into the model, detail on what each connector imports, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
